name: kubequest
description: KubeQuest: a conference game where points come from showing up, listening and meeting people

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w app" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.build: if [ -f web/package.json ]; then npm run build -w web; fi && npm run build -w app
